en: All four channels read live via Chrome on 14 Sep. This is the first scan since 11 Sep — the 12 and 13 Sep runs did not happen, so every comparison below is against 11 Sep.
The Meta and YouTube windows rolled THREE days forward to 16 Aug – 12 Sep; LinkedIn finally advanced too, to 13 Aug – 11 Sep, after several cycles stuck on 10 Aug – 8 Sep.
Facebook: views 4,284 → 4,394 (▼11.2% against the prior period, easing from ▼15.7%). 9 Sep (625 views) is still the window's peak and 10 Sep entered at 255.
Video remains Facebook's strongest line: 3-second views 254 → 274 (▲80.3%) and watch time 1h 20m → 1h 26m (▲29.9%).
But Facebook viewers fell again 302 → 283 (▼49.1%) and link clicks 6 → 5 (▼64.3%) — more views from fewer people, and almost nobody clicking through to the site.
Instagram surged: views 1,619 → 1,849 (▲94.4%, nearly double the prior period) while reach slipped 181 → 178 (▼36.4%). 9 Sep (440 views on 14 reach) is still carrying the whole number.
Instagram followers supply 61.4% of views (1,233, ▲24.0%); the non-follower share is 616 (▼23.6%). Non-follower reach 162 (▼37.9%) — new discovery keeps contracting.
YouTube read cleanly this cycle: views 407 → 409 ('309 more than usual'), watch time held at 0.4 hrs (▼85%). Realtime 48-hour views collapsed 125 → 4: the Short's wave is over.
STILL ZERO NEW SUBSCRIBERS: about 387 views across the two Shorts, subscribers exactly 4. The CTA gap is now into its second week.
LinkedIn advanced its window and the numbers genuinely moved: impressions 1,226 → 1,446 (▼17.6%), reactions 87 → 82 (▲15.5%), comments 0, reposts 0.
LinkedIn visitors jumped: page views 112 → 113 (▲140.4%) and unique visitors 42 → 43 (▲95.5%); 75 desktop / 38 mobile. Information Technology 5 → 8 is the fastest-moving job function.
One new post this cycle: the 12 Sep 'Good design has to work beyond the drawing' post (FB 34 views, IG 4 reach). The 11 Sep journal post matured 5 → 73 views on Facebook.
The follower base is completely flat: FB 116 / IG 48 / LI 101 / YT 4. Instagram posts 122 → 123.
